== Biography ==
<i>A History of Rockbridge County, Virginia</i> by Oren Frederick Morton includes a [https://archive.org/details/historyofrockbri00mortrich/page/304/mode/1up biography] of "Squire Glasgow" which was provided by his daughter Elizabeth Glasgow MacCorckle.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2070]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The 1874 Virginia marriage index identifies John Glasgow in Alexander M. Glasgow’s marriage, reinforced by the daughter-supplied 1920 Rockbridge biography and McNutt family context. The exact 1820 birth fits John-2070’s 1785 generation and 1815 McNutt marriage.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.

Next useful test: Inspect Alexander’s 1874 marriage original for both parents.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XRH9-26R "Virginia, Marriages, 1785-1940", FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XRH9-26R : 2 September 2020), Alex. M. Glasgow, 1874.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


According to his [https://images.findagrave.com/photos/2017/151/12380387_1496359626.jpg obituary], Alexander Glasgow was a nephew of [[McNutt-265|Alexander McNutt]], a man that served as Governor of Mississippi.
